note: R1 pins no approval key. The key belongs to the maintainer: its private half never enters this repository and never enters the process, and no step of the evidence-regeneration workflow has been approved yet. A null key means that no approval artifact can be verified and therefore that no provider dispatch can be authorised - the intended state of R1 (every stage is PROVISIONAL_ONLY / NOT_DISPATCHABLE). The key is added here when the maintainer approves a step; the artifact itself is handed to the run out of band.
